All other main pages were already clean.

ROUTE_META in App.js defines unique title for /quiz but the /quiz component likely redirects to /diagnose if no in-progress session — so direct visits to /quiz inherit /diagnose title. Functionally correct, just note for SEO indexing that /quiz canonical likely never gets indexed standalone.

rca of the issue: No blocker bugs. The 3 em-dashes on /close were inside pricing range copy ('10 % – 50 %'). Root cause: when iter30 swept em-dashes across copy, the pricingConstants.js + PriceCards.jsx range expressions were missed because en-dash (U+2013) is the canonical numeric-range separator and was easy to overlook. Mitigation applied: replace with 'bis' (Wlad-Sprache, lesbarer Deutsch). Resend issue from iter30 ('API key is invalid') is FULLY RESOLVED with the new LIVE key — backend logs now show 200 OK + Resend message id for welcome emails.
